article.title: 更進新聞：OpenAI試推ChatGPT Wallet，代理付款須逐筆確認
article.summary: OpenAI開始在dots逐步推出ChatGPT Wallet，首階段面向持有合資格美國發行支付卡的成年美國ChatGPT Pro用戶。
highlights: 用戶每次付款前須核對商品及總額，再通過安全確認。
付款網絡以支付代碼替代實際卡資料。
article.why: 電商團隊可檢查現有結帳是否支援這類交易，以及客服能否辨識代理完成的訂單。
article.next_step: 與支付服務商核對交易識別、拒絕原因及退款流程，再安排測試。
article.detail: OpenAI表示，用戶先加卡，每次購買仍須核對商品、總額及所選卡片，並通過安全確認。付款網絡提供代碼，代理及商戶不會取得實際卡資料。商戶仍負責定價、履約和退貨。首階段透過dots逐步開放，電商團隊可用現有支付和客服流程評估相容性。可先向支付服務商了解代理交易被拒時會如何顯示。
article.title_en: Update: OpenAI starts ChatGPT Wallet rollout with per-purchase approval
article.summary_en: OpenAI began rolling out ChatGPT Wallet in dots to eligible adult US ChatGPT Pro subscribers with eligible US-issued cards.
highlights_en: Users review the items and total and complete a security check before each purchase.
The payment network substitutes a payment token for actual card details.
article.why_en: Commerce teams can check checkout compatibility and whether support staff can identify agent-assisted orders.
article.next_step_en: Check transaction identification, decline reasons and refunds with your payments provider before testing.
article.detail_en: OpenAI says users add a card and then review the items, total and selected card and pass a security check for each purchase. The network supplies a token so neither the agent nor the business receives actual card details. Merchants remain responsible for pricing, fulfilment and returns. The rollout starts in dots, giving merchants a specific flow to assess with their payments and service teams. Ask the payments provider how a declined agent-assisted transaction is displayed.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
article.followup: 11月13日版報道ChatGPT商家中心。今次新增的是OpenAI在dots推出的逐筆確認付款功能。
article.followup_en: The November 13 edition covered Business Hub. The new development is purchase-by-purchase payment approval in dots.
